notes:
Page content: The leaf asks whether an extension of E_k by π defines an admissible outer action arising from an algebraic curve, and questions which curve could realise it. A left marginal qualification says that an innocent arithmetisation of π is always available. The next paragraph considers composing sections of (30) and (31), thereby obtaining the action called effective, and asks what to expect from it. The author then describes unexpectedly touching the structure of the moduli varieties named here, with the form after l-apostrophe left as infinity|os and proposes a Conjecture-à-tout-hasard. The two conditions written here are that U_eta have good reduction over S and that the outer action of T on π be trivial. This is a conjectural equivalence on the page, not a proved theorem.

Visual review: The whole leaf and both full-resolution halves were read once, including every word and symbol on which C and H agree. There are twenty main rows, a four-row slanted marginal note, one interlinear insertion effective, the author number 50, and foliation 100 in another unnamed hand. There is no display, diagram or drawing. Seventeen saved unique crops cover the word differences, supplied doubts and crowded/open places, including H’s omitted underline beneath quelle. The marginal crop was rotated −30 degrees after its original box was recorded. No OCR, external research, recropping or compilation was used. The effective leader lands between action and de.

Literal reading decisions: The source has only the terminal point in i e.; the i’s upper dot is not an abbreviation stop. In the marginal arithmetisation, no opening quote pair and no detached accent over e are visible; the closing pair is retained without balancing it. Inexistant has no final e. Celle ci has no hyphen. The two separate marks after structure are a colon, despite the syntax that would suggest à; the nearby à before tâter has a distinct small a body. The source’s full heading and its underline are retained. The same-page complete item confirms U_eta locally without turning its rounded subscript into K. The top-half view and des_lors crop show the compact accent in Dès.

Unresolved state and shape: The heavy lower stroke beneath Sans joins the S foot and low letters, favouring live Sans, but a cancellation remains an explicit alternative. The question mark after admissible is overwritten and remains doubtful in form and live/cancelled state. A single short oblique mark lies over the u of Teichmüller; the letter sequence is clear, while the single grave-like stroke favors ù and ü remains an explicit alternative. Faint hollow traces above the earlier part of that name are much lighter than the body ink and are not transcribed as an extra word.

Actual mathematical checks: This reader performed no independent mathematical proof, computation, use or refutation. The check_events list is empty. All checks reported above are visual reading and attachment checks. The adjective effective is transcribed without treating it as a demonstrated claim of faithfulness. Main review: the whole source leaf and all seventeen saved crops were visually inspected. The literal i e., unaccented marginal arithmetisation with its closing quote pair only, masculine inexistant, colon after structure, and unhyphenated celle ci are confirmed. The crowded question-mark state, Sans deletion state, and the exact diacritic over the u of the proper name remain explicit doubts. Both supplied word marks are resolved from their crops. No mathematical theorem is claimed from this visual review.

Blind adjudication inspected all14 token-different crops and one focused detail of the tiny form after l-apostrophe. The phrase si ce n-est is replaced by si on vise from its v and dotted i. The retraced question mark now retains cancellation as an alternative. The name keeps a single-mark preference ù|ü, and the two-lobed infinity|os form remains explicitly uncertain; its interpretation is not used as a mathematical premise. Quelle, inexistant, the slanted tjrs/arithmetisation/innocente note, avec, attendre, scabreuse and etre celle ci retain their first readings after comparison of the specific competing letters. The author number50 and margin100 remain separate. This was a visual adjudication, with no new mathematical check.
